name: Lag-First Traversal
definition: A ray divergence handling technique where lagging rays within an RP are selectively advanced to promote convergence with leading rays, mitigating throughput degradation caused by rays entering distinct voxels.
summary: Lag-first traversal is a ray divergence handling technique that selectively advances lagging rays in a packet to promote convergence with leading rays, thereby restoring parallelism and reducing redundant empty volume traversal operations.
